title: Encrypted SQLite snapshot store with transactional mutation
description: Spec §6.1-6.3. One encrypted logical snapshot per vault in ward.db (0600) under ~/.ward (0700); immediate transactions, revision increment, rollback on failure, bounded busy timeout, no plaintext index, SQL tracing off.

acceptanceCriteria.text: T05 (store slice): synthetic plaintext is absent from database, journals and sidecars after create/update/delete and forced failures
T06: concurrent writes preserve both updates or report conflict; an interrupted write leaves the last committed snapshot valid
T07: directory/file modes and ownership enforced; symlink and path-traversal inputs rejected
